description: This file defines a controller class 'Item' for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically for shipping extension management in the admin panel. It contains methods for rendering the shipping item configuration page and saving its settings.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Controller class managing the shipping item configuration page in the admin area of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the shipping item settings page, including breadcrumbs, form data, and layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the shipping item settings, with permission check and JSON response.
